name: Aristotle University of Thessaloniki
summary: Thessaloniki public university with 41 undergraduate programmes; seven are fee-paying and English-taught, from Medicine and Law to Clean Energy.

handoff.label: English-taught bachelor's in Greece (Study in Greece)

ib.text: No fixed IB score: most degrees take the IB Diploma and count 28 points in your favour; Sport asks 28 and Medicine adds an admission test. Three sciences need Maths, Physics and Chemistry passed.

lastYear.text: rolling; each programme sets its own

apply.via: Each programme's own online application form

dates.label: Materials Science: confirm your place and pay first semester

programmes.name: Clean Energy Science and Engineering
programmes.about: Clean-energy technologies studied through chemistry, physics, engineering design and sustainability, run jointly by three AUTh schools, with laboratory work and modelling throughout (240 ECTS).
programmes.ib: No IB minimum; IB 23 points counts in your favour. Maths, Physics and Chemistry must appear on the final-year transcript; B2 English; online interview.

needs.note: Examined in Mathematics in the final year

programmes.selectionNote: File review (motivation letter, CV, results) then a short online interview on Physics, Chemistry, Maths and English; no entrance exam. Rolling, so apply early.

programmes.name: Materials Science and Engineering
programmes.about: Five-year integrated master's (300 ECTS, EQF level 7) in materials science and engineering: core sciences, laboratory training, advanced specialisation and a two-semester research thesis.
programmes.ib: No IB minimum; IB 28 points counts in your favour. Maths, Physics and Chemistry must appear on the final-year transcript; B2 English; online interview.

needs.note: Examined in Mathematics in the final year

programmes.selectionNote: Applications are reviewed in order of receipt: documents, motivation letter and CV, then an online interview. No separate requirements for EU citizens.

programmes.name: Environmental Sciences and Engineering
programmes.about: Five-year integrated master's (300 ECTS) co-designed by five AUTh schools: physics, chemistry, biology, mechanical engineering and agriculture applied to climate, water, energy and ecosystems, ending in a thesis.
programmes.ib: No IB minimum; IB 28 points counts in your favour. Maths, Physics and Chemistry must appear on the final-year transcript; B2 English; online interview.

needs.note: Examined in Mathematics in the final year

programmes.selectionNote: File review then an online interview, sometimes a knowledge test; a €150 file fee is paid when you apply. The cycle takes 24 to 40 students.

programmes.name: Sustainable Agriculture and Food Science
programmes.about: Five-year integrated master's (300 ECTS) from the Agriculture and Chemistry schools: plant and animal production, food chemistry and technology, specialisms in year four and a research thesis. First cohort September 2027.
programmes.ib: No IB minimum or required subjects; IB 28 points counts in your favour. B2 English, online interview.
programmes.selectionNote: File review (motivation letter, CV, results), then an online interview and possibly an English test; a €150 file fee is paid when you apply. Takes 15 to 40 students.

programmes.name: Sport and Exercise Sciences for Health and Performance
programmes.about: Four-year BSc (240 ECTS) in sport and exercise science, with laboratory teaching from the first semester: anatomy, physiology, biomechanics and training science, then one of two pathways in year four.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma with at least 28 points and grade 5 or higher in two relevant HL subjects; biology, sport science or psychology at HL suit best. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.selectionNote: Reviewed on a rolling basis on results, a personal statement and possibly an online interview. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.)
programmes.about: Four-year LL.B. (240 ECTS) taught in English in the civil-law tradition, with a common-law elective track and courses in European, international, digital and maritime law.
programmes.ib: No IB minimum; IB 28 points counts in your favour. B2 English (IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 79); predicted IB grades accepted for final-year applicants; online interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Committee file review, an online interview and sometimes a knowledge test; decisions within 15 working days of the interview. Rolling admissions.

programmes.name: Medicine (English-taught Medical Degree)
programmes.about: Six-year medical degree in English (360 ECTS) for students who did their final school years abroad: clinical skills from the first semester, hospital rotations from year four, full-time clinical training in the last year.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma accepted with no minimum stated; an online Biology and Chemistry admission test, English proof and an interview, unless you hold MediTest-EU or final A-levels AAB.
programmes.selectionNote: Online application, then an interview and a 60-question multiple-choice test on high-school Biology, Chemistry and reasoning. Two cycles for 2027 entry.

notes: Every English-taught degree is open to applicants who did their last two school years outside Greece; Greek-taught AUTh places are allocated by the Ministry of Education, not by AUTh.
Most degrees decide by file review and online interview; IB 28 points (23 for Clean Energy) counts in your favour rather than as a minimum. Three need Maths, Physics and Chemistry on the transcript.
The deposit on acceptance (€1,000 to €6,000) is non-refundable, and Environmental Sciences and Sustainable Agriculture also charge a €150 file fee at application.
